review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer (integreation and verification) - Avionics sector
review_candidates.description: We are Gilat. Anywhere on the planet and in space, we bring Boundless Communications. At Gilat Satellite Networks, (NASDAQ: GILT, TASE: GILT) we’re not just shaping the future of satellite communications—we’re transforming how the world connects. From bridging the digital divide to powering in-flight connectivity and delivering combat-proven advanced SATCOM solutions, we're driving deep-tech satellite innovation. We believe in the right of all people to be connected and are united in our resolution to provide communication solutions to all reaches of the world. Gilat Stellar Blu , a wholly owned subsidiary of Gilat, specializes in providing advanced satellite communication solutions for in-flight connectivity. With a focus on delivering reliable, high-speed satellite services to the aerospace industry, Gilat Stellar Blu enables seamless, scalable connectivity for commercial and business aviation. We are looking for a Systems IV&V Engineer for our Avionics division to support the integration, verification, and validation of certified avionics products. This role works closely with senior engineers to perform testing, system integration, requirements verification, troubleshooting, documentation, and certification support, contributing to the delivery of safe and reliable avionics solutions. Annual base salary range: $85 ,000–$90,000 USD What You Will Do Develop and execute test plans, test procedures, and test cases. Translate system and customer requirements into verification activities. Assist with troubleshooting and issue resolution during integration and testing. Support certification and compliance efforts, including requirements traceability and test documentation. Maintain verification records, test results, and technical reports. Contribute to automation, lab infrastructure, and process improvement initiatives. Collaborate with systems, hardware, software, and program teams throughout the product lifecycle. Follow engineering standards, quality requirements, and safety practices. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Systems, Aerospace, Electrical, Software, Computer Engineering, or a related field. At least 2-5 years of experience in systems engineering, avionics, aerospace, embedded systems, testing, or related technical environments. Knowledge of systems integration, verification, and validation principles. Familiarity with avionics or embedded systems and hardware/software integration. Experience with Linux or Windows environments. Exposure to communication interfaces such as Ethernet, ARINC 429, CAN Bus, or serial protocols is an advantage. Familiarity with engineering tools such as Git, Jira, Confluence, Python, or similar tools. Understanding of the system development lifecycle and configuration management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills. Experience with avionics certification standards (e.g., DO-160) and lab test equipment is a plus. Work Environment This role operates in indoor settings, including office and warehouse/airplane hangar environments, requiring the use of standard office equipment and safety gear. Occasional exposure to fumes, airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, and vibration may occur. Work Authorization Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. Equal Employment Opportunity Gilat Stellar Blu provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. SBS also takes affirmative action as required by applicable laws and Executive Orders to ensure diversity and inclusion in our workforce.ovative team committed to advancing aerospace technology through meticulous system integration and verification! Pay: $85,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

review_candidates.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer based in India. Join a global Platform Engineering team responsible for building and evolving the shared Azure services that power multiple SaaS environments. You’ll combine hands-on cloud engineering with a strong internal consulting role, helping product and engineering teams adopt secure, scalable platform capabilities. The environment is Azure-first and PaaS-first, with infrastructure fully managed through Terraform and modern CI/CD practices. You’ll work across networking, identity, API management, messaging, security, automation, and observability. A key part of the role is partnering with MLOps teams to enable Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, and model-serving workloads. This is an opportunity to influence platform architecture, improve reliability, and continuously develop your expertise in a fast-moving cloud environment. Accountabilities Design, build, maintain, and enhance shared Azure platform services used across multiple product families, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, secure, and easy for engineering teams to consume. Own infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, provider management, plan and apply reviews, imports, drift remediation, and safe promotion of changes across environments. Serve as an internal platform consultant by onboarding engineering teams, reviewing solution designs, troubleshooting integrations, documenting self-service patterns, and helping teams make effective use of shared services. Build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, application deployments, Databricks assets, and repeatable multi-environment releases. Manage Azure networking and edge services, including Application Gateway, WAF, Traffic Manager, TLS, routing, listeners, backend pools, health probes, rewrite rules, and multi-region failover configurations. Manage identity and access through Entra ID, including application registrations, OAuth 2.0/OIDC flows, service principals, managed identities, API permissions, and Azure RBAC. Configure and maintain Azure AD B2C, including custom Identity Experience Framework policies, SSO XML configurations, and integrations with external identity providers. Operate Azure API Management, covering APIs, products, subscriptions, policies, named values, versioning, revisions, and automated deployment through Terraform and pipelines. Manage Azure Service Bus namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions, filters, access policies, and permissions through infrastructure as code. Partner with MLOps teams to deploy and configure Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, endpoints, Databricks environments, Unity Catalog, clusters, workflows, notebooks, jobs, and DLT pipelines. Implement AI guardrails, content-safety controls, private networking, private endpoints, identity integrations, and auditable deployment processes that enable secure model and data operations. Automate security, compliance, cost, and resource-usage controls while monitoring deployment processes and continuously improving platform reliability and efficiency. Establish business-focused KPIs and reliability targets, using measurable outcomes to guide operational improvements and demonstrate the platform team's impact. Participate actively in Agile delivery, taking ownership of sprint commitments, keeping work and documentation current, and contributing to a fast-paced, high-standard engineering environment. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with proven experience supporting Azure infrastructure and CI/CD for SaaS products at scale. Deep hands-on experience with Azure App Service/Web Apps, Azure Functions, and Azure Container Apps, including deployment slots, scaling, VNet integration, and configuration management. Strong expertise in Azure networking and edge services, including Application Gateway, WAF, Traffic Manager, VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, hub-and-spoke architectures, Private Endpoints, and Private DNS. Extensive experience with Azure Service Bus, including namespaces, queues, topics, subscriptions, filters, rules, shared access policies, and permissions. Strong Azure API Management experience, including policy authoring, products, subscriptions, named values, versioning, revisions, and infrastructure-as-code deployments. Solid knowledge of Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, service principals, managed identities, API permissions, token and claims configuration, and Azure RBAC. Hands-on experience with Azure AD B2C, custom policies, Identity Experience Framework XML, and SAML/OIDC federation with external identity providers. Strong Terraform expertise, including reusable modules, remote state, workspaces, provider/version management, plan and apply workflows, imports, drift remediation, and using Terraform as the primary mechanism for resource changes. Strong Azure DevOps experience with YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, environments, approvals, service connections, and secure variable and secret management. Strong scripting and automation capabilities using PowerShell and/or Bash, together with fluent use of Azure CLI and solid Git practices including branching, pull requests, and code reviews. Strong understanding of cloud security, least-privilege access, secrets management, network isolation, certificate lifecycle management, and compliance controls. Working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases, strong analytical skills, and a proven ability to improve infrastructure reliability through measurable outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical platform decisions clearly to engineers and stakeholders across disciplines. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment, manage competing priorities, assimilate information quickly, and deliver projects on schedule. Preferred experience includes Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Databricks administration, Unity Catalog, Databricks Asset Bundles, the Databricks Terraform provider, MLOps, AI guardrails, content safety, Azure Data Factory, Docker, monitoring and security platforms, and relevant Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-500. Familiarity with C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/React is advantageous for reading application code and troubleshooting deployment or configuration issues alongside product teams. Kubernetes experience is not required. Benefits Opportunity to work on a global Azure platform supporting multiple SaaS environments and product families. Hands-on exposure to modern Azure PaaS, serverless, infrastructure-as-code, DevOps, MLOps, AI, and data technologies. Significant technical ownership and influence over shared platform architecture, reliability, security, and engineering standards. Collaboration with product engineering, MLOps, data, and other technical teams across a global environment. Continuous opportunities to expand expertise across Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, automation, cloud security, and platform engineering. A collaborative, inclusive environment that values accountability, innovation, action, customer focus, and knowledge sharing. The opportunity to contribute to technology that supports safer, more sustainable, and productive operations across industries. review_candidates.title: Senior Network & IT Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Network & IT SupportFirst Principles Engineer & Senior Team Member We’re hiring for our Network & IT Support team , but we’re not looking for someone whose idea of a good day is closing 20 tickets. In fact, we’d rather you prevent those 20 tickets from being created in the first place. Our team is small. Two people support close to 300 employees across Manila, Canada, and a 24-hour operation. That means we need engineers who think differently. When the same issue happens for the third time, we don't want you to become faster at fixing it. We want you to ask why it's happening at all - and eliminate it. When you see repetitive manual work, we expect you to ask whether it can be automated. When equipment, Wi-Fi, network infrastructure, endpoints, access, or security controls are likely to become problems, we want you checking them before employees discover the problem for you. When something breaks at 2 AM and you're the person on shift, we need you to be able to investigate incomplete information, form your own hypotheses, eliminate possibilities, make sound decisions, and restore operations without waiting for someone senior to tell you what to do. And when everything is working? Don't wait for the next ticket. Look at the environment and ask: What could fail next? What keeps repeating? What are we doing manually that shouldn't be manual? What can I simplify, automate, standardize, document, monitor, or permanently eliminate? That's what ownership means here. We're hiring at two levels:✨ FPE / First Principles Engineer • This is our leadership-level individual contributor. We need someone who can look beyond individual incidents and own the health and direction of the entire function - identify systemic weaknesses, prioritize improvements, design better processes and architecture, automate repetitive work, establish standards, use data to find patterns, and make the engineers around them more effective. You shouldn't need someone to continuously tell you what needs improving. You should be the person finding it. ✨ Senior Team Member - Network & IT Support We need a strong hands-on operator who can independently own a shift and keep the business running. You'll troubleshoot network, endpoint, access, infrastructure and production-impacting issues - but troubleshooting ability alone isn't enough. We need someone who sees recurring problems and closes the loop permanently . Someone who can say: "This kept happening. I investigated why. I found the root cause. I changed something. I verified it worked. And now nobody has to deal with that problem anymore." That's the standard. We're less interested in how many technologies you've touched than in how you think, what you've personally improved, and what happens to an environment after you've owned it for six months. If your instinct is to own the problem rather than escalate it, prevent rather than repeatedly repair, and improve systems rather than simply maintain them , we'd like to hear from you. We're building a small team. That means every person has to make the team disproportionately better. You won't always have a runbook. You won't always have someone to escalate to. And the problem in front of you may be something you've never encountered before. That's okay. What matters is whether you can work the problem — gather evidence, test your assumptions, change direction when the evidence tells you you're wrong, and keep going until you understand what is actually happening. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to figure things out. Before you apply Please apply if you read the expectations above and can confidently say: “I've worked this way before, I've been successful doing it, and this is the level of ownership I want again.” We're not looking for someone who wants to learn how to become proactive or who believes they could operate this way given the opportunity. We're looking for people who can point to real examples where they have already owned difficult problems, worked through ambiguity, eliminated recurring issues, improved an environment, and made things better than they found them. For the FPE role, that bar is even higher. We expect evidence that you've done this beyond your own individual workload - that you've identified systemic problems, driven improvements across a function, established better ways of working, and raised the effectiveness of the people around you. So before applying, ask yourself: Have I actually done this before? Was I personally responsible for it? Can I explain what I changed and prove that it worked? And am I prepared to take that level of ownership here? If the answer is genuinely yes , we'd really like to meet you.
